topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Well, this morning the sun rose as usual, but the news was a fresh shock to the soil of our routines. Master John, who's been a stable hand in the fields of the manor, is now to tend to the beasts in the stables. I had my doubts, mind you, for the chores are different, and the beasts have their own peculiar ways. But I see in his eyes a light, a glint that wasn't there when he toiled under the scorching sun, day in and day out. Perhaps the change is a blessing, like rain after a long drought. Saints be praised, we all seek our own patch of fertile ground, even if it means walking where we've never stepped before.
